qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree with B.Ed and CTET, Master's Degree with B.Ed and CTET, Diploma in Elementary Education with CTET Paper-I, B.El.Ed with CTET, Diploma in Music/Performing Arts, D.E.C.Ed or B.Ed (Nursery)
qualification.details: ECCE Trained Balvatika Teacher: Senior Secondary with 50% marks and Diploma in nursery/Pre-school/Early Childhood Education (D.E.C.Ed) or B.Ed (Nursery) from NCTE recognised institutions. PRT (Primary Teacher): Senior Secondary with 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education or B.El.Ed or 2-year Diploma in Special Education (RCI) with CTET Paper-I and proficiency in Hindi and English. PRT (Music): Senior Secondary with 50% marks and Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts with music as main subject and working knowledge of Hindi & English. TGT (English): Bachelor's Degree with 50% marks + B.Ed with CTET Paper-II and English as main subject for 3 years/6 semesters. TGT (Sanskrit): Bachelor's Degree with 50% marks + B.Ed with CTET Paper-II and Sanskrit as main subject for 3 years/6 semesters. PGT (Chemistry): Master's Degree in Chemistry with 50% marks + B.Ed from NCTE recognised institution. PGT (Maths): Master's Degree in Mathematics with 50% marks + B.Ed from NCTE recognised institution. PGT (Computer Science): B.E/B.Tech (CS/IT) or M.Sc (CS)/MCA or B.Sc (CS)/BCA + PG degree or DOEACC 'B'/'C' Level with 50% marks. PGT (Economics): Master's Degree in Economics with 50% marks + B.Ed from NCTE recognised institution.

selection_process: Walk-in Interview Screening Test (if candidates exceed limit) Document Verification

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KV Gaya and Bodhgaya Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KV Gaya and Bodhgaya?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview dates are scheduled for 25th September 2026 and 26th September 2026, depending on the post. Candidates should check the specific date for their desired post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for PRT posts?
faq.answer: For PRT posts, candidates need Senior Secondary with 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education or B.El.Ed or a 2-year Diploma in Special Education (RCI) with CTET Paper-I, along with Hindi and English proficiency.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for KV Gaya and Bodhgaya recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the registration and interview time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: The registration time is 09:00 AM, and the interview time is 10:00 AM on the respective walk-in dates.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, and a Screening Test may be conducted if the number of candidates exceeds the limit, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at Kendriya Vidyalaya Gaya and Bodhgaya, located in Gaya, Bihar, with pincode 823245.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is strictly through a Walk-in Interview process, and online applications are not accepted.
